p0.original: 关键问题：心理学家如何解释群体间的智商差异
p0.en: Key issue: How psychologists explain IQ differences between groups

p2.original: 尽管大多数心理学家认同遗传和环境都会影响智力，但是对于种族间和社会群体间的智商差异的来源，他们仍存在分歧。
p2.en: Although most psychologists agree that genetic and environmental influences affect mentality, they still differ as to the sources of intellectual differences between races and social groups.

p3.original: 虽然我们发现在每个种族群体中，人们的智商分数都分布于整个分数范围，但我们也发现，不同群体间存在着智商差异（Rushton & Jensen，2005）。在美国，亚裔美国人的智商分数，平均来说，要高于欧裔美国人；而西班牙裔美国人、非裔美国人和美国原住民——也是平均来说——得分更低。我们还发现了基于社会阶层的群体差异：来自中等收入家庭的儿童比那些来自低收入家庭的儿童在智商测验中的得分更高（Jensen & Figueroa，1975；Oakland & Glutting，1990）。没有人否认这些差异的存在。让专家们产生分歧的是造成这些差异的原因。正如我们将看到的，这种分歧是先天-后天之争的又一个例子。思考核心概念所描述的问题：
p3.en: While we have found that the IQ scores are distributed across all ethnic groups, we have also found that there are IQ differences between different groups (Rushton & Jensen, 2005). In the United States, Asian-American IQ scores, on average, are higher than European-Americans; And Spanish Americans, African Americans and Native Americans — on average — scored lower. We have also found group differences based on social class: children from middle-income families score higher in IQ tests than those from low-income families (Jensen & Figueroa, 1975); Oakland & Glutting, 1990. No one denies the existence of these differences. The differences among the experts are due to the reasons for these differences. As we will see, this disagreement is yet another example of the innate-posterate struggle. Thinking about the issues described in the core concept:

p4.original: 尽管大多数心理学家认同遗传和环境都会影响智力，但是对于种族间和社会群体间的智商差异的来源，他们仍存在分歧。
p4.en: Although most psychologists agree that genetic and environmental influences affect mentality, they still differ as to the sources of intellectual differences between races and social groups.

p5.original: 智力的起源之争对人们的生活可能具有重要意义。它也是政治上的一个热点问题。而当涉及种族问题时，这类问题就变得更加热门。虽然说人类不同“种族”的概念没有确切的生物学意义，但它确实具有社会意义（Cooper，2005；Sternberg et al.，2005）。
p5.en: The struggle for intellectual origin can be important to people's lives. It is also a political hotshot. When it comes to ethnic issues, such issues become more topical. Although the concept of different “races” of humankind has no precise biological significance, it does have social significance (Cooper, 2005); Sternberg et al., 2005).

p6.original: 如果我们假设智力主要由先天（遗传）因素所决定，我们将很有可能得出它是固定不变的这一结论。一方面，对有些人来说，这很容易让他们得出这样的结论：智商分数较低的群体（通常是指种族群体）一定是天生低人一等，或许他们应该被视为二等公民。另一方面，如果我们得出智力主要由经验（环境）所塑造这一结论，我们更有可能为每个人都提供一系列的教育机会，也更有可能平等地看待所有种族、文化和经济群体的人。无论怎样，我们的结论都可能成为自我实现预言。
p6.en: If we assume that intelligence is largely determined by congenital (genetic) factors, it is very likely that we will come to the conclusion that it is fixed. On the one hand, for some, it is easy for them to conclude that groups with lower IQs (usually racial groups) must be naturally inferior, perhaps they should be considered second-class citizens. On the other hand, if we come to the conclusion that intelligence is largely shaped by experience (environment), we are more likely to provide everyone with a range of educational opportunities and to view people of all ethnic, cultural and economic groups equally. In any case, our conclusions could become a self-fulfilling prophecy.

p7.original: 20世纪初，亨利·戈达德（Henry Goddard），一位十分有影响力的心理学家，认为智力是一种遗传特质，提议让所有移民都接受测验，以驱逐那些被测出有“智力缺陷”的人（Strickland，2000）。1924年，国会通过立法，限制那些来自被“证明”为智力低下——主要基于戈达德的数据——的群体和民族的移民。这些被限制的群体包括犹太人、意大利人和俄罗斯人。被戈达德和美国国会忽视的是，这些测验都是用英文施测，而施测对象常常是那些对英语以及对测验题目所涉及的文化不怎么熟悉的人。难怪这些移民中的许多人都得到很低的分数！
p7.en: At the beginning of the twentieth century, Henry Goddard, a very influential psychologist, identified intelligence as a genetic characteristic, proposed that all immigrants be tested for expulsion of those detected as having “intellectual impairment” (Strickland, 2000). In 1924, Congress passed legislation to restrict immigrants from groups and ethnic groups that had been “proven” to be mentally retarded, mainly on the basis of Goddard data. These restricted groups include Jews, Italians and Russians. What has been ignored by Goddard and the United States Congress is that these tests are conducted in English, and that they are often directed at people who are not very familiar with English and the culture involved in the subjects. No wonder many of these immigrants get low scores!

p8.original: 如今，我们对智力测验的缺点有了更多的了解。我们也知道，不仅遗传会对个体的智力产生影响，经验也会产生影响。我们还知道，戈达德在得出遗传能够解释群体间智力差异这一结论时，使用了错误的推理。
p8.en: Today, we have a better understanding of the shortcomings of intelligence tests. We also know that not only is genetic influence on the individual's intelligence, but experience also has an impact. We also know that Goddard used the wrong reasoning in drawing the conclusion that genetics can explain inter-group intellectual differences.

p9.original: 实际上，遗传论者的观点或环境论者的观点都不完全正确。本书已反复谈到，心理学家现在认识到遗传和环境都会在我们所有的行为和心理过程中发挥作用。但群体差异的问题远不止于此。在这一学习阶段中，我们将讨论遗传-环境交互作用的一种重要的复杂情形：虽然每个个体的智力一部分由遗传决定，但这并不意味着群体间的智商差异存在某些生物基础。相反，许多心理学家都认为，群体差异完全是环境造成的——尽管如核心概念所说，这种观点也存在争议。历史上，先天主义者对于智商问题的立场受到了最多的关注——但研究结果表明了什么？为了理解遗传如何影响个体差异而对群体差异没有影响，让我们先来看看支持遗传论者和环境论者观点的证据。
p9.en: In fact, the views of geneticists or environmentalists are not entirely correct. As the book has repeatedly stated, psychologists now recognize the role that genetics and the environment play in all our behaviour and psychological processes. But the problem of group differences goes far beyond that. During this learning phase, we will discuss an important complication of genetic-environmental interactions: while the intellectual component of each individual is determined by genetics, this does not mean that there are certain biological bases for differences in the intellectual intelligence of the group. On the contrary, many psychologists believe that group differences are purely environmental — even though, as the core concept suggests, this view is controversial. Historically, the position of congenitalists on IQ issues has received the most attention — but what does the study show? In order to understand how genetics affect individual differences without affecting group differences, let us first look at the evidence that supports the views of geneticists and environmentalists.

p14.original: 6.14 哪些证据表明智力受到遗传影响

p16.original: 解释遗传对智力的平均贡献程度。
p16.en: Explain the average contribution of genetics to intelligence.

p17.original: 许多研究都表明智力受遗传影响。对同卵双生子与异卵双生子及一般兄弟姐妹的智商分数进行比较的研究显示出很强的遗传相关。区分遗传影响和环境影响的黄金标准，是观察由养父母抚养的孩子，在极少数情况下，需要观察在出生时就被分开的双胞胎。这样的研究表明，儿童与其亲生父母的智商关联要比与其养父母的智商关联更为密切（Plomin & DeFries，1998）。人类基因组计划的工作也支持智力具有遗传成分，很可能涉及许多基因的交互作用这一观点（Chorney et al.，1998）。趋势很明显：基因关系越密切——从堂表兄弟姐妹到兄弟姐妹再到双胞胎——智商分数间的关联就越密切，如表6-7所示。
p17.en: Many studies have shown that the brain is genetically affected. A comparison of the IQ scores of twins and twins and siblings in general shows a strong genetic correlation. The gold criterion for distinguishing between genetic and environmental effects is the observation of children raised by adoptive parents, and in very few cases of twins separated at birth. Such studies have shown that children are more closely connected to their biological parents' IQ than to their adoptive parents' (Plomin & DeFries, 1998). The work of the Human Genome Programme also supports the idea that the intellectual component is genetic and is likely to involve the interaction of many genes (Chorney et al., 1998). The trend is clear: the closer the genetic relationship - from cousins and siblings to siblings to twins - the closer the correlation between IQ scores, as shown in Table 6-7.

p21.original: 事实上，对双生子和收养儿童的研究揭示了遗传对各种属性的影响，如心脏功能（Brown，1990）、人格特质（Tellegen et al.，1988）、催眠易感性（hypnotizability，Morgan et al.，1970）和智力（Sternberg et al.，2005）等。
p21.en: In fact, studies of twins and adopted children reveal the effects of genetics on a variety of attributes, such as heart function (Brown, 1990), personality characteristics (Tellegen et al., 1988), hypnosis (hypnotizability, Morgan et al., 1970) and intelligence (Sternberg et al., 2005).

p22.original: 虽然心理学家赞同遗传在决定个人智商分数中发挥着重要作用，但他们也赞同，要估计遗传和环境的相对权重仍然很困难（Sternberg et al.，2005）。一个原因是，生活在相同家庭环境中的孩子不一定会拥有完全相同的心理环境。例如，第一个孩子和最小的孩子会受到不同的对待（你能想出其中一些原因吗）。
p22.en: While psychologists agree that genetics play an important role in determining individual IQ scores, they also agree that it is still difficult to estimate the relative weight of genetics and the environment (Sternberg et al., 2005). One reason is that children living in the same family environment do not necessarily have the same psychological environment. For example, the first child and the youngest child are treated differently (can you think of some of these reasons).

p23.original: 6.15 哪些证据表明智力受到环境影响

p25.original: 考查环境在塑造智力中的作用。
p25.en: To examine the role of the environment in shaping intelligence.

p26.original: 环境影响智力发展的证据也十分有说服力。例如，在一项对110名贫困家庭儿童的纵向研究中（Farah et al.，2008），研究人员评估了儿童的语言能力和记忆力（智力的两个重要方面）。他们还就这两个因素评估了儿童的家庭环境。
p26.en: Evidence of environmental impacts on intellectual development is also compelling. For example, in a longitudinal study of 110 children from poor families (Farah et al., 2008), researchers assessed the linguistic abilities and memory of children (two important aspects of intelligence). They also assessed the child's family environment in relation to both factors.

p27.original: （1）它们的刺激丰富性（stimulating）如何？（通过儿童对书本、乐器这些东西的接触情况来进行判断。）
p27.en: (1) What about their stimulating richness? (Assured by children's exposure to books, musical instruments, etc. I don't think so.

p28.en: (2) How is their atmosphere nourishing? ( Ratings based on observations of positive emotional climate, as well as parents ' interest in and praise of children. I don't think so.

p29.original: 这项研究既证明了我们的预期，也揭示了我们未预料到的结果。
p29.en: This study has proven both our expectations and our unforeseen results.

p30.original: 刺激丰富的环境与语言能力密切相关，与记忆力无关。
p30.en: Stimulating a rich environment is closely linked to language skills and has nothing to do with memory.

p31.original: 氛围滋养的环境与记忆力有关，而与语言能力无关。
p31.en: The atmosphere is nourished by memory and not by language skills.

p32.original: 我们如何解释这些结果？父母养育和记忆力之间的关系与动物研究中的父母的陪伴养育会减少应激的结果相一致——既然应激激素的产生会干扰记忆，那么父母养育也许可以通过减少应激激素来提高儿童的记忆力，这完全说得通。环境刺激的丰富性与语言能力有关联，印证了许多发现丰富环境对认知发展有积极影响的研究结果。
p32.en: How do we explain these results? The relationship between parental upbringing and memory is consistent with the fact that accompanying parenting in animal studies reduces stress - since the generation of stress hormones can interfere with memory, it is perfectly understandable that parental care may improve the memory of children by reducing stress hormones. The richness of environmental incentives is linked to language skills, and many studies have been found to have a positive impact on cognitive development.

p33.original: 即使我们正在探讨遗传的影响，环境的影响也会在此时显露出来：我们发现，被一起抚养的人的智商相似性高于被分开抚养的人的智商相似性。而且，对于实验室动物，生命早期居住在刺激丰富的环境，会使它们的脑细胞和皮层区域发育得更为复杂和完全。这些动物在一系列任务中的优异表现会持续一生。在其他实验中，我们发现，那些被训练去解决问题并且有其他猴子陪伴的幼猴，比那些没有这种环境刺激的幼猴表现出更活跃的好奇心和更高的智力。
p33.en: Even as we are looking at the effects of genetics, the effects of the environment will be felt at this time: we find that the IQs of those who are being raised together are more similar than those of those who are being raised separately. Moreover, for laboratory animals, the early life of living in a stimulating environment makes the development of their brain cells and cortical areas more complex and complete. These animals will last a lifetime in a series of missions. In other experiments, we have found that young monkeys trained to solve problems and accompanied by other monkeys are more active in curiosity and intelligence than those who do not have the incentive to do so.

p34.original: 这些发现提示，我们可以通过丰富人类婴儿的环境来提高他们的智力。的确，我们可以看到，早期干预计划能够提高儿童的智商分数（Barlow，2008）。此外，儿童的受教育程度与他们的智商分数高度相关（Ceci & Williams，1997）。即使对于一个成年人，环境因素，如工作的认知复杂性和智力需要，也能对其一生的心理能力产生影响（Dixon et al.，1985）。
p34.en: These discoveries suggest that we can improve the intelligence of human babies by enriching their environment. Indeed, we can see that early intervention programmes can increase the IQ score for children (Barlow, 2008). In addition, children's educational attainment is highly correlated with their IQ scores (Ceci & Williams, 1997). Even for an adult, environmental factors, such as cognitive complexity and intellectual needs of the job, can influence the mental ability of the adult (Dixon et al., 1985).

p35.original: 然而，现在有越来越多的证据表明，欧裔美国人和非裔美国人的智商差距正在缩小（Dickens & Flynn，2006）——进一步支持了群体智商差异的起因是环境而不是遗传的观点。研究人员分析了过去30年内4个不同智商测验的大数据后发现差距的缩小量高达50%——接近于8分（Krakovsky，2007）。在智力的先天-后天之争中，支持环境（后天）立场的证据还有很多，但想要理解它们，我们必须先停下来去探讨一个重要但常被误解的概念：遗传力。
p35.en: However, there is growing evidence that the IQ gap between European and African Americans is narrowing (Dickens & Flynn, 2006) — further supporting a group of IQ differences from an environmental rather than a genetic point of view. Researchers have analysed large data from four different IQ tests over the past 30 years and have found that the gap has narrowed by as much as 50 per cent — close to eight points (Krakovsky, 2007). There is much evidence of support for the environmental (post-natural) position in the intellectual innate-post-day struggle, but to understand them, we must stop and explore an important but often misunderstood concept: geneticity.

p36.original: 6.16 遗传力（不是遗传）与群体差异

p38.original: 描述表明社会和环境对智力的贡献的研究结果。
p38.en: Describe the results of the research that demonstrates the social and environmental contribution to intelligence.

p39.original: 总之，我们都认同智力有遗传成分（Dickens & Flynn，2001；Neisser et al.，1996）。但是遗传对个体智力的影响并不意味着遗传能够解释我们在群体间观察到的差异。要理解为什么会这样，我们需要区分遗传（heredity）和另一个重要术语——遗传力（heritability）。具体来说，遗传力是指群体内可归因于遗传差异的特质的变异量（见图6-7）。
p39.en: In short, we all agree that there is a genetic component to intelligence (Dickens & Flynn, 2001); (a) The right to freedom of expression; But the effect of genetics on individual intelligence does not mean that genetics can explain the differences that we observe between groups. To understand why this is happening, we need to distinguish between genetics and another important term, genetics. In particular, geneticity refers to the variation of the quality within the group that can be attributed to genetic differences (see figure 6-7).

p41.original: 由于人们接触的文化传统不同，财富水平和受歧视情况也不同，因而我们没有办法评估群体间的差异有多少比例由遗传来解释，又有多少比例由环境来解释。重申一遍：遗传力的概念指的是群体内差异，而不是群体间差异。因此，认识到我们只能在处于基本相同环境的一个群体内来讨论遗传差异，是很重要的（Sternberg et al.，2005）。
p41.en: Because people are exposed to different cultural traditions and different levels of wealth and discrimination, we do not have the means to assess how much of the differences between groups are explained by genetics and how much by the environment. Repeat: The concept of geneticity refers to intra-group differences, not inter-group differences. It is therefore important to recognize that we can only discuss genetic differences within a group in essentially the same environment (Sternberg et al., 2005).

p42.original: 还有一点也值得重申，因为它常混杂在对遗传力的讨论中：生物学家（包括那些致力于人类基因组计划的人）已经确定，“种族”（race）不是一个有效的生物学概念（Cooper，2005；Sternberg et al.，2005）。并没有一个用于定义不同种族的生物界线。即使我们使用的是人们用以界定自己种族群体的社会性定义，不同种族群体的基因库之间的差异，与同一群体内个体间的基因差异相比，也微乎其微（Bamshad & Olson，2003）。由于以上这些原因，证据并不支持遗传差异导致了“种族”群体间的智商差异。
p42.en: It is also worth reiterating that it is often mixed in the discussion of genetics: biologists, including those working on the human genome programme, have identified “race” as not an effective biological concept (Cooper, 2005); Sternberg et al., 2005). There is no biological boundary for defining different races. Even if we use the social definition used to define our ethnic group, the differences between the gene pool of different ethnic groups are minimal compared to the genetic differences among individuals within the same group (Bamshad & Olson, 2003). For these reasons, the evidence does not support genetic differences leading to differences in IQ between “ethnic” groups.

p44.original: 尽管存在刚才提及的这些问题，一些心理学家仍不相信环境能解释智商的群体差异（Nisbett，2005；Rushton & Jensen，2005）。例如，20世纪60年代，哈佛大学心理学家阿瑟·詹森（Jensen，1969）就声称，智商的种族差异有很强的遗传基础。詹森说，通过帮助穷人和弱势群体，我们能够在一定程度上提高他们的智商分数，但这也受遗传限制。
p44.en: Despite the problems just mentioned, some psychologists do not believe that the environment can explain the differences among groups with IQ (Nisbett, 2005); Rushton & Jensen, 2005. For example, in the 1960s, Harvard University psychologist Jensen (Jensen, 1969) claimed that racial differences in IQs had a strong genetic base. Jensen said that by helping the poor and vulnerable, we could raise their IQ scores to some extent, but that was also genetic.

p45.original: 为了支持自己的论点，詹森引用了一些表明遗传对智商有很显著影响的研究。他还给出了一个复杂的统计论证，表明环境对智商和成就的影响很弱。之后，詹森将关注点转向那些试图为生活条件差的黑人儿童提供额外帮助的政府计划。他说，虽然大多数计划都显示出了一些积极的效果，但它们都没有消除成绩上的种族差异。他坚持认为，没有被消除掉的一定就是能力的遗传差异。
p45.en: In support of its arguments, Jensen cited studies that showed that genetics had a significant impact on IQs. He also gave a complex statistical case showing the weak impact of the environment on IQs and achievements. Subsequently, Jensen turned his focus to Government plans that sought to provide additional help to black children living in poor conditions. He stated that while most plans had shown some positive results, they had not eliminated ethnic disparities in their achievements. He maintains that what has not been eliminated must be the genetic difference in capacity.

p46.original: 在接下来的5年里，有100多篇发表的文章回应了詹森的挑战。在一场激烈的辩论中，批评家指出了詹森轻视或忽略的几个因素，包括种族主义的影响、教师对黑人儿童的较低期望、机会的缺乏、低自尊，以及在智商测验和成就测验中存在的白人中产阶级偏向（Neisser，1997；Neisser et al.，1996）。虽然詹森在2012年去世前一直坚持他原来的主张（Jensen，1998，2000），但现在许多心理学家都认同，一些环境因素组合起来能够解释詹森赖以立论的种族差异。现在，让我们看看詹森之后的一些发现，我们将从一项儿童研究开始，这些儿童所处的环境因收养而发生了改变。
p46.en: Over the next five years, more than 100 articles have been published to respond to Jason's challenges. In a heated debate, critics pointed to several factors that Jensen despised or ignored, including the impact of racism, the lower expectations of teachers for black children, the lack of opportunities, low self-esteem and the bias of the white middle class in IQ and achievement tests (Neisser, 1997); (a) The right to freedom of expression; Although Jensen maintained his original claim until his death in 2012 (Jensen, 1998, 2000), many psychologists now agree that a combination of environmental factors can explain the racial differences in Jensen's doctrine. Now, let us look at some of the findings after Jensen that we will start with a study of children whose environment has changed as a result of adoption.

p47.original: 6.16.2 斯卡尔与温伯格的收养研究

p48.original: 由桑德拉·斯卡尔（Sandra Scarr）与理查德·温伯格（Richard Weinberg，1976，1978）开展的一项意义深远的研究探讨了这个问题。该研究比较了被明尼苏达相似家庭环境所收养的115名黑人和白人儿童。该研究使用了亲生家庭和收养家庭的教育背景数据和智商测验分数数据。两组儿童亲生父母的智商分数皆为均值（接近100分），而养父母的智商都稍微高一些，平均在115分以上。
p48.en: A far-reaching study by Sandra Scarr and Richard Weinberg, 1976, 1978, explored the issue. The study compares 115 black and white children adopted in a similar family environment in Minnesota. The study used data on the educational background of biological and adoptive families and data on IQ scores. Both groups of children have an average IQ score (almost 100 points), while foster parents have a slightly higher IQ, averaging over 115 points.

p49.original: 当斯卡尔与温伯格重新测量了这些儿童青春期后期的智商分数时，他们发现了什么？两组没有差异！黑人组和白人组的平均智商都在110分左右——尽管不像他们养父母的智商那样高，但均明显高于他们亲生父母的智商。这些结果证实了环境对智商的强大影响。研究结果也与詹森的群体差异是遗传的主张相矛盾。
p49.en: What did Skar and Weinberg find when they re-measured the IQ scores of these children in the later stages of adolescence? There's no difference between the two teams! Both black and white groups have an average IQ of about 110 points - although not as high as their foster parents' IQ, they are significantly higher than their biological parents' IQ. These results confirm the strong impact of the environment on IQ. The results of the study also contradicted the idea that the differences between Jansen's groups were genetic.

p51.original: 类似的环境效应出现在有关社会阶层和智商之间关系的研究中。社会经济阶层（反映在一个人的经济状况与生活方式上）与智商显著相关：富裕与较高智商分数相联系，而智商分数最低的群体经历着最高程度的贫困、文盲（illiteracy）和绝望。环境主张的支持者声称，种族主义与歧视最初使许多少数种族落户于贫困社区，甚至直至今日这些因素仍迫使他们继续留在那里。
p51.en: Similar environmental effects are found in studies on the relationship between social class and IQ. The socio-economic class (reflected in a person's economic situation and lifestyle) is significantly linked to IQ: wealth is associated with higher IQ scores, while the lowest IQ score groups experience the highest levels of poverty, illiteracy and despair. Proponents of environmental claims claim that racism and discrimination initially left many ethnic minorities in poor communities, and even today these factors force them to remain there.

p52.original: 社会阶层如何影响智商？它们的关系并不简单：在贫困家庭中长大所带来的消极影响，要远大于在富裕家庭中长大所带来的优势（Turkheimer et al.，2003）。事实上，贫困环境在许多方面都限制着个人的潜能，特别是在营养、卫生保健和教育方面（Brown & Pollitt，1996；Neisser et al.，1996）。贫困也意味着卫生保健的不足，因此，研究人员将儿童在胎儿期的身体欠佳、低出生体重与低心理能力联系起来也就不足为奇了。研究还表明，有相当比例的低智商儿童受到了“环境污染”的不利影响。例如，住在有铅基漆屑从墙上剥落的家里，导致儿童接触了毒铅（Needleman et al.，1990）。贫困也意味着与促进智力发展的其他因素接触更少，如良好的营养与接触书本和计算机的机会。繁重的工作安排让父母没有时间去激发儿童的智力，这也与贫困相关，而且可能不利于在诸如智商测验要求的任务（如词汇或句子理解）上的表现。事实上，2015年的一项新研究对1000多名青少年和年轻人做了脑扫描，结果表明那些在贫穷条件下长大的人比那些在优越条件下长大的人，脑质量要少6%（Noble et al.，2015）。
p52.en: How does the social class influence IQ? Their relationship is not simple: the negative effects of growing up in poor households are far greater than the advantages of growing up in rich households (Turkheimmer et al., 2003). In fact, the poor environment limits the individual's potential in many ways, particularly in nutrition, health care and education (Brown & Pollitt, 1996); (a) The right to freedom of expression; Poverty also means inadequate health care, and it is therefore not surprising that researchers link poor health during the foetal period, low birth weight and low mental capacity. Studies also show that a significant proportion of children with low IQ are adversely affected by “environmental pollution”. For example, living in a home with lead-based paints that are stripped from the wall leads to exposure to toxic lead (Needleman et al., 1990). Poverty also means less exposure to other factors that promote intellectual development, such as good nutrition and access to books and computers. The heavy working arrangements that leave parents with little time to motivate children are also poverty-related and may be detrimental to performance in tasks such as those required by IQ tests (e.g., vocabulary or sentence understanding). In fact, a new study in 2015 scanned over 1,000 young people and adolescents, and found that those growing up in conditions of poverty were 6 per cent less brain quality than those growing up in conditions of superiority (Noble et al., 2015).

p53.original: 贫穷还会带来其他破坏性影响。在美国的大部分地区，公立学校由当地的财产税收所资助。因此，富裕社区能够提供更大、更好的学校设施和便利设施；而较贫穷社区则可能受到拥挤、设施老化、人身安全威胁、教师资源不足和无法使用计算机的困扰。在这样的环境中，即使是那些有学习能力的儿童也会觉得很难摆脱自己的处境。支持环境对智力有很大影响的人们，通常会支持机会均等的立法、更好的学校，以及支持那些帮助弱势儿童建立自信、学习能够帮助其取得学业成功所需技能的干预计划（Tirozzi & Uro，1997）。
p53.en: Poverty can also have other devastating effects. In most parts of the United States, public schools are financed by local property taxes. As a result, richer communities are able to provide greater and better school facilities and amenities; Poorer communities, on the other hand, may be plagued by overcrowding, ageing facilities, threats to physical security, insufficient resources for teachers and lack of access to computers. In such an environment, even those who are able to learn find it difficult to escape their situation. Supporting people whose environment has a significant impact on their mental capacities usually supports equal opportunity legislation, better schools, and intervention programmes that help vulnerable children build self-confidence and learn the skills they need to succeed in their studies (Tirozzi & Uro, 1997).

p54.original: 让我们将关注点转回遗传力上，来看看那些注重比较同一家庭中儿童的智商差异与不同家庭中儿童的智商差异的研究。在母亲受教育程度低的家庭中，来自家庭内共享环境的环境因素能解释的智商变异，要大于家庭间遗传差异能解释的智商变异。而母亲受过良好教育的儿童则正好相反，对他们来说，遗传的影响更大。这再次说明，在丰富的环境中，遗传的影响更大；而在贫困的环境中，环境的影响更大（Nisbett et al.，2012）。
p54.en: Let us turn our attention back to genetics and look at those studies that focus on comparing the differences in the IQ of children in the same family with the differences in the IQ of children in different families. In households with a low level of education of the mother, the IQ variability explained by environmental factors of shared environment within the family is greater than the IQ variation explained by genetic differences between families. In contrast, children whose mothers are well educated have a greater genetic impact. This is yet another indication of the greater genetic impact in a rich environment; The impact of the environment is greater in poor environments (Nisbett et al., 2012).

p55.original: 6.16.4 开端计划：一个成功的干预计划
p55.en: 6.16.4 Beginning Plan: A Successful Intervention Plan

p56.original: 开端计划（Head Start）最初实施于20世纪60年代，旨在给那些弱势儿童提供丰富的教育资源。这项计划来源于这样的假设：许多来自贫困家庭的儿童的智力需要获得增长来为入学做好准备。这项计划旨在通过营养和医疗支持，以及一两年的学前教育，来满足儿童的身心需要，从而从多方面解决问题。明智的是，开端计划还让父母参与制定政策、规划项目、参与到课堂中，以及学习有关为人父母和儿童发展的知识。目前，全美各地的开端计划中心每年都为大约900000名儿童提供服务（U.S. Department of Health and Human Services，2011——估计占到需要该服务的儿童的40%，Ripple et al.，1999）。
p56.en: The Head Start initiative, originally implemented in the 1960s, was designed to provide a wealth of educational resources to vulnerable children. The plan is based on the assumption that the intellectual needs of many children from poor families will grow to prepare for school. The programme aims to address the physical and mental needs of children through nutrition and medical support, as well as one or two years of pre-school education, in a multifaceted manner. It is wise that the start-up plan also involves parents in policy formulation, project planning, participation in the classroom and learning about parenting and child development. At present, start-up planning centres throughout the United States provide services to approximately 900,000 children annually (U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 2011 - estimated at 40 per cent of children in need, Ripple et al., 1999).

p57.original: 它是否有效？尽管存在一些争议（Jensen，1969；Kantrowitz，1992），但有大量研究表明，开端计划确实会帮助弱势儿童做好入学准备（Garces et al.，2002；Ripple & Zigler，2003）。与未接受这种干预的完全匹配的控制组相比，参与该计划的低年级儿童在智商测试中得分更高，有更高的学业成就（Zigler & Styfco，1994）。更重要的是，他们的领先优势会一直持续下去。虽然开端计划的儿童与控制组儿童之间的差异会随着时间的推移而缩小，但这种影响会一直持续到青春期。此外，参与开端计划的儿童被安排到特殊教育班级及挂科的可能性更小，他们更有可能从高中毕业，触犯法律的可能性也更小。
p57.en: Does it work? Despite some controversy (Jensen, 1969); Kantrowitz, 1992, but there is a great deal of research that shows that start-up programmes do prepare vulnerable children for school (Garces et al., 2002); Ripple & Zigler, 2003. Children in the lower grades who participated in the scheme scored higher in IQ tests and had higher academic achievement than fully matched control teams who did not accept such intervention (Zigler & Styfco, 1994). More importantly, their lead will continue. Although the difference between children in the start-up plan and those in the control group will diminish over time, the impact will continue into adolescence. In addition, children who are involved in the start-up programme are less likely to be placed in special education classes and courses, more likely to graduate from high school and less likely to be in conflict with the law.

p58.original: 虽然开端计划有积极作用，但较新的研究表明，这类计划可能开始得还不够早。大多参与开端计划的儿童都是学龄前儿童，但与控制组相比，出生后头几个月开始的教育干预就能将婴儿的智力测验分数提高30%（Ramey & Ramey，1998a，1998b；Wickelgren，1999）。虽然这种提高可能会随着时间的推移而减少，特别是在支持性计划被撤销的情况下，但如果干预始于婴儿期，那么显著的差异会继续存在。显然，儿童越早浸入丰富环境，效果越强。
p58.en: While the start-up plans have been positive, more recent studies have shown that they may not have started early enough. Most of the children involved in the start-up programme are pre-school children, but educational interventions in the first few months of life increase infant intelligence scores by 30 per cent compared to control groups (Ramey & Ramey, 1998a, 1998b); Wickelgren, 1999. While this increase may decrease over time, especially in the case of the withdrawal of supportive schemes, significant differences continue to exist if interventions begin in infancy. It is clear that the sooner children are immersed in a rich environment, the more effective they are.

p59.original: 6.16.5 测验偏向与文化公平测验
p59.en: 6.16.5 Tests of bias and cultural equity

p60.original: 还有其他因素会影响智商分数并导致群体差异，其中包括智商测验本身的问题。许多心理学家认为，智商测验题存在内在的偏向，偏向于中产或上层阶级——也就是偏向于白人儿童（Helms，1992）。然而，一种相反观点则认为，测验偏向不会造成智商分数的群体差异，这可以参见詹森（Jensen，2000）和雷诺兹（Reynolds，2000）的研究。
p60.en: There are other factors that influence IQ scores and lead to group differences, including the problem of IQ tests themselves. Many psychologists believe that the IQ test is inherently biased towards middle or upper classes - i.e. white children (Helms, 1992). However, a contrary view is that bias does not result in differences among groups with IQ scores, as can be seen from the study by Jensen and Reynolds 2000.

p61.original: 偏向的一个可能来源是，大多数智商测验都十分依赖于词汇水平。这就给那些曾经听过别人阅读、被鼓励阅读的儿童带来了很大优势。我们能从某著名智商测验中看到这样的偏向。该测验要求对“opulent”（富有）下定义，而这个词在贫困家庭中被使用的可能性要小得多。不过，值得称赞的是，测验编制者正在努力去除那些歧视少数文化的测验题目（Benson，2003）。
p61.en: One possible source of bias is that most IQ tests rely heavily on terminology levels. This has brought great advantages to children who have heard others read and are encouraged to read. We can see this bias from a famous IQ test. The test requires a definition of “opulent”, which is much less likely to be used in poor families. It is commendable, however, that the authors of the tests are working to remove the subjects of the tests that discriminate against minority cultures (Benson, 2003).

p62.original: 著名心理学家珍妮特·赫尔姆斯（Helms，1992）指出了当前智商测验中另一个可能潜在的缺陷：它“假定了美国白人文化塑造了最能帮助智力充分发展的环境”。我们很少询问白人儿童对其他文化规范有何了解——这是一个具有挑衅性的、相当合理的问题。根据赫尔姆斯的说法，为什么美国白种人的规范应该成为评判其他人的标准？
p62.en: Another potential flaw in the current IQ test was identified by the famous psychologist Janet Helms: “Assuming that the white American culture has shaped the environment most conducive to full intellectual development”. We rarely ask about the knowledge of white children of other cultural norms — a provocative and quite reasonable question. Why, according to Helms, should the norms of the whites in the United States be the judge of others?

p63.original: 心理学家认识到，能力测验或成就测验不可能不涉及文化。不过，大多数心理学家都同意，我们应该为那些尽量最小化文化偏向的文化公平（culture-fair）测验而努力。例如，心理学家正尝试开发包含迷宫和形状操纵的非言语智力测验，以克服由非母语建构测验所带来的偏向。
p63.en: Psychologists recognize that a competency test or an achievement test cannot be cultural-neutral. However, most psychologists agree that we should work for the cultural equity (culture-fair) tests that minimize cultural bias. For example, psychologists are trying to develop non-verbal intelligence tests that include mazes and shape manipulation to overcome the bias of non-mother tongue construction tests.

p64.original: 尽管考虑到了减少歧视的重要性，但是以文化公平为目标的测验可能又会受到哪些批评呢？
p64.en: While the importance of reducing discrimination was taken into account, what criticism could be drawn from tests aimed at cultural equity?

p65.original: 1. 并非所有少数群体都在传统智力测验中表现不佳。例如，我们已经看到，亚裔美国人经常比欧裔美国人表现得更好（Sue & Okazaki，1990）。
p65.en: 1. Not all minorities are underperforming in traditional intelligence tests. For example, we have seen Asian Americans often perform better than European Americans (Sue & Okazaki, 1990).

p66.original: 2. 文化公平测验比传统的智商测验在预测学业成功上的效果更差：由于不强调言语技能，它们也就不能评估学业成绩中一个非常重要的组成部分（Aiken，1987；Humphreys，1988）。
p66.en: 2. Cultural equity tests are less effective in predicting academic success than traditional IQ tests: they cannot assess a very important component of academic achievement without emphasizing speech skills (Aiken, 1987); Humphreys, 1988.

p67.original: 6.16.6 钟形曲线：遗传论者的又一次进攻
p67.en: 6.16.6 Bell curve: another attack by a geneticist

p68.original: 关于智商种族差异的起因的争论于1994年再次爆发。争论的焦点是理查德·赫恩斯坦（Richard Herrnstein）与查尔斯·默里（Charles Murray）写的一本书，《钟形曲线：美国生活中的智力和阶层结构》（The Bell Curve: Intelligence and Class Structure in American Life，以下简称为《钟形曲线》）。它的名字与智商分数的钟形“正态分布”相呼应。赫恩斯坦与默里认为，智商的种族差异有很强的基因基础。他们说，如果接受这些先天差异，国家就可以为此制定更开明、更人道的社会政策。批评者立即指出其中存在种族偏见，并指出作为这本书核心的科学论证存在问题。
p68.en: The debate on the causes of ethnic differences in IQs erupted again in 1994. The debate focused on a book written by Richard Herrnstein and Charles Murray, The Bell Curve: Intelligence and Crass History in American Life. Its name corresponds to the "normal distribution" of the IQ fraction clock. Henstein and Murray believe that the ethnic differences in IQ have a strong genetic base. They said that if these congenital differences were accepted, the State could develop more enlightened and humane social policies to that end. Critics immediately pointed to racial bias and pointed out that the scientific argument at the heart of the book was problematic.

p69.original: 《钟形曲线》中的论证有何问题？你现在应该已经很熟悉答案了：虽然遗传毫无疑问会影响个体智力，但赫恩斯坦和默里，像他们之前的遗传论者一样，并没有提供证据证明，接触不同环境的不同群体之间的差异具有遗传基础（Coughlin，1994；Fraser，1995）。此外，他们提供的许多“证据”都是可疑的（Kamin，1994）。赫恩斯坦与默里引用过的一项研究声称其记录了非洲黑人的低智商，但这是用英语测验做出来的，而研究中的祖鲁被试的英语并不流利（Kamin，1995）。该研究使用的测验还假定被试熟悉城市中产阶级家庭（而不是祖鲁村庄）里的电器，以及如显微镜这类在祖鲁学校中不常见到的设备。
p69.en: What is the problem with the reasoning in the bell curve? You should be familiar with the answer now: although genetics undoubtedly affect individual intelligence, Heinstein and Murray, like their former geneticists, do not provide evidence that differences between groups exposed to different environments have a genetic basis (Coughlin, 1994); Fraser, 1995. Moreover, many of the “evidences” they provide are suspicious (Kamin, 1994). A study cited by Hernstein and Murray claims to have documented the low IQ of black Africans, but this was done in English, where Zulu was tested without fluency (Kamin, 1995). The tests used in the study also assumed that electrical appliances in urban middle-class households (rather than in the village of Zulu) and equipment such as microscopes, which were not common in Zulu schools, were tested.

p70.original: 赫恩斯坦与默里犯了另一个我们在本书中已反复强调过的批判性思维的错误：他们混淆了相关与因果。这使得他们在分析证据时的问题更为复杂。事实上，赫恩斯坦与默里的观点反过来似乎也合理：贫穷以及与之相伴的所有社会与经济劣势也可能是低智商分数的重要原因，而非结果。
p70.en: Heinstein and Murray have made another critical thinking mistake that we have repeatedly emphasized in this book: they confuse the relevance and the causes. This complicates their analysis of the evidence. Indeed, the views of Hernstein and Murray seem to be in turn valid: poverty and all the social and economic disadvantages associated with it can also be important reasons for low IQ scores, not outcomes.

p71.original: 虽然《钟形曲线》一书存在问题，但它还是引起了许多美国人的共鸣。该书观点与美国人偏好对行为进行简单遗传“归因”而非进行更复杂的解释的观点相一致。但并非所有文化都如此重视遗传原因。在一项要求美国人和亚洲人对儿童学业成功进行归因的研究中，我们可以看到不同的观点：美国受访者强调“先天能力”，而亚洲受访者则强调“努力学习”的重要性（Stevenson et al.，1993）。因此，个体间和群体间的成绩差异具有先天基础这个想法，是美国文化中的一种普遍信念。然而有趣的是，斯坦福大学教授卡罗尔·德韦克（Dweck，2007，2008）的研究表明，当父母和老师采用类似于亚洲文化倡导的方法时，他们的孩子对上学更感兴趣、学得更多，也取得了更优秀的成绩。
p71.en: Although there is a problem with the bell curve, it resonates with many Americans. The book's view is consistent with that of the American preference for a simple genetic “substantiation” of conduct rather than a more complex interpretation. But not all cultures give such importance to genetic causes. In a study that requires Americans and Asians to attribute the success of a child's education, we can see different perspectives: American interviewees emphasize “innate ability”, while Asian interviewees emphasize the importance of “learning hard” (Stevenson et al., 1993). Thus, the idea that individual and group differences in performance are innate is a universal belief in American culture. Interestingly enough, however, a study by a professor at Stanford University, Dweck 2007, 2008 shows that when parents and teachers adopt methods similar to Asian cultural advocacy, their children are more interested in, learn more and achieve better results in school.

p72.original: 6.16.7 思维模式与刻板印象威胁

p73.original: 卡罗尔·德韦克对智力的兴趣始于六年级，当时她的老师威尔逊夫人（Mrs. Wilson）根据学生的智商分数来分配教室座位，高智商学生还可以享受某些特权，如做旗手；而低智商学生则不能。德韦克回忆道：“她让大家知道，智商对她来说是衡量智力和性格的最终标准。因此，坐在最好位置的学生总是害怕参加下一次测验，因为他们担心自己不再名列前茅。”（Trei，2007）
p73.en: Carol Dewek's interest in intelligence began in the sixth grade, when her teacher, Mrs. Wilson, allocated classroom seats based on the student's IQ score, and high-level IQ students also enjoyed certain privileges, such as being a flagman; But IQ students can't. Dewey said, “She lets you know that IQ is the ultimate measure of intelligence and character for her. As a result, the best-placed students are always afraid to take the next test because they are afraid that they will no longer be among the top. (Trei, 2007)

p74.original: 许多年后，德韦克教授认识到，大多数人持有下列两种智力观中的一种，她称之为思维模式（mindsets）。
p74.en: Many years later, Professor Dewey realized that most people held one of the following two intellectual expressions, which she called the mindset (mindsets).

p75.original: 一种思维模式认为智力是固定的或相对不变的。
p75.en: A pattern of thinking considers intelligence to be fixed or relatively constant.

p76.original: 另一种思维模式认为智力是流动的或可变的，既取决于先天能力，也取决于动机和经验。
p76.en: Another pattern of thinking considers intelligence to be mobile or variable, depending on both congenital abilities and motivation and experience.

p77.original: 她的研究不仅支持了这种二分法，而且表明你的智商分数依赖于你相信哪个“理论”。
p77.en: Her research not only supports this dichotomy, but also shows that your IQ scores depend on which “theory” you believe.

p78.original: 在一项干预研究中，她的团队指导一组初中生掌握学习技能，并且告诉他们，大脑就像肌肉一样越用越强。她将这个观点称作“成长型思维模式”。控制组被试接受了相同的学习技能训练，但没被告知他们的心理能力可以得到发展。如果你猜到第一组——具有成长型思维模式的组——的成绩显著提高，而控制组没有，那么你就猜对了（Blackwell et al.，2007）。你可以在网络上搜索观看德韦克教授关于思维模式力量的TED演讲。
p78.en: In an intervention study, her team mentored a group of junior high school students to acquire learning skills and told them that the brain used more and more like muscles. She called it a “growth thinking model”. Control teams were tested for the same learning skills, but were not informed that their psychological abilities could be developed. If you guess the performance of the first group — the group with the growth mode of thinking — has improved significantly, and the control group does not, you're right (Blackwell et al., 2007). You can look online and watch Professor Dewey's TED speech on the power of thinking.

p79.original: 不幸的是，许多人相信他们的“聪明”水平是既定的。而且，如德韦克的工作所表明的那样，他们常常会抵达（或不辜负）自己的期望。这当然是期望偏差（expectancy bias）和自我实现预言在起作用。但还有一种关联的思维模式可能更为狡猾，因为它可以在我们意识的边缘起作用。心理学家克劳德·斯蒂尔（Claude Steele）称之为刻板印象威胁（stereotype threat）。
p79.en: Unfortunately, many believe that their “smart” level is established. Moreover, as the work of Devereaux has shown, they often reach (or fail) their expectations. This is certainly the effect of expectations and self-fulfillment predictions. But there is also a related mindset that may be more subtle, because it can work on the margins of our consciousness. A psychologist, Claude Steele, calls it a steeodype threat.

p80.original: 以下是刻板印象威胁的作用原理：当来自某些群体（即那些被普遍认为不太聪明、技术水平低的群体）的成员被提醒有关自身群体的刻板印象时，结果可能是毁灭性的，尤其是在课堂上（Schwartz，1997；Steele，1997；Steele et al.，2002）。一项研究发现，仅仅是被要求确认他们的种族，就会导致少数族群的学生在学业能力测验中的分数更低（Steele，1997）。在另一项研究中，一组接受智商测验的黑人女性被告知，白人女性通常会在这个测验中表现得更好。这种刻板印象威胁的结果是，与被告知黑人女性通常会得高分的对照组相比，这组黑人女性的平均分低了整整10分（Thomas，1991）。
p80.en: The following is the rationale behind the threat of stereotypes: when members from certain groups (i.e. those who are generally considered less intelligent and less skilled) are reminded of the stereotypes of their own groups, the results can be devastating, especially in the classroom (Schwartz, 1997); Steele 1997;, One study found that simply being asked to identify their race would result in students from minority communities having lower scores in the academic ability test (Steele, 1997). In another study, a group of black women who had undergone an IQ test were told that white women were usually better represented in the test. As a result of this stereotyped threat, the average black women score is exactly 10 points lower than that of the control group that was told that black women usually scored high (Thomas, 1991).

p81.original: 刻板印象威胁不只是种族或民族问题。我们发现，它还存在于性别领域：女孩可能会在科学和数学方面感到自卑；而男孩则可能被告知他们的言语能力较差。刻板印象威胁也会使那些担心记忆衰退或那些担心自己学不会新东西的老年人感到焦虑。任何相信自己属于低等群体的人都容易受到焦虑感、恐吓感和自卑感的影响。
p81.en: Stereotyping threats are not just a matter of race or ethnicity. We find that it also exists in the area of gender: girls may feel inferior in science and mathematics; Boys, on the other hand, may be told that they are less able to speak. Stereotyping threats can also cause anxiety among older people who fear memory loss or who fear that they will learn nothing new. Anyone who believes that they belong to a lower group is vulnerable to anxiety, intimidation and low self-esteem.

p82.original: 有方法对抗刻板印象威胁吗？社会心理学家约书亚·阿伦森和他的同事们（Aronson et al.，2001）发现，鼓励大学生将智力看作受经验和预期影响而一种非固定特质时，他们的成绩就会有所提高。实际上，非裔美国学生的成绩比白人学生和控制组学生提高得更多。显然，那些有可能认为自己是刻板印象威胁目标的人从该项目中获益最多。关于刻板印象威胁的新研究还表明，当刻板印象被消除或被抵制时，女性和男性在非传统领域中的较差表现，以及少数族群在非传统领域中的较差表现，都可能被扭转。
p82.en: Is there a way to counter the threat of stereotypes? Social psychologist Joshua Arlensen and his colleagues (Aronson et al., 2001) found that university students ' performance improved when they were encouraged to view their intelligence as a non-fixed feature influenced by experience and expectations. In fact, African-American students have improved their performance more than white students and control group students. It is clear that those who may consider themselves as the target of the threat of stereotypes benefit most from the project. New studies on the threat of stereotypes also show that when stereotypes are eliminated or resisted, the poor performance of women and men in non-traditional fields, as well as the poor performance of minority communities in non-traditional areas, can be reversed.

p83.original: 心理学很有用 大脑训练计划：它们是否有效
p83.en: Psychology works. Brain training programs: Are they working?

p84.original: 除非你在过去几年与世隔绝，否则你肯定看到过这样的广告：神经科学家已经开发出能够增强注意力，提高记忆力，使你成为更好的问题解决者，以及总体上提高你的认知能力的“大脑训练”计划——当然是要付费的。其中一个名为Lumosity的计划声称，它有超过7000万名用户。还有其他的包括名为BrainHQ和名为Cogmed的计划。但它们是否如其所宣传得那般好呢？
p84.en: Unless you are isolated from the world in the past few years, you must have seen the ad: neuroscientists have developed a “brain-training” programme that can increase attention, enhance memory, make you a better problem solver and, in general, improve your cognitive capabilities — and pay for it. One of the projects, Lumosity, claims that it has more than 70 million users. Other projects include the BrainHQ and Cogmed. But are they as good as they preach?

p85.original: 浏览一下它们的网站，你会在各个计划的员工栏中都看到一些年轻神经科学家的照片，还会看到声称验证其方法的研究列表。这些网站强烈暗示（但未明说），大脑训练可能可以预防或治疗智力衰退和痴呆症（dementia，Koenig，2014），这迎合了老年人内心的恐惧。其中的研究似乎表明，大脑训练在学校中得到了广泛应用。
p85.en: Look at their websites, you'll see pictures of young neuroscientists in the staff columns of the various programs, and you'll see a list of studies that claim to validate their methods. These sites strongly suggest (but not explicitly) that brain training may prevent or treat intellectual deflation and dementia (dementia, Koenig, 2014), which caters for the fear within older persons. Research in this area seems to indicate that brain training is widely used in schools.

p86.original: 然而，更仔细地审视这些研究，你就会发现一些重大问题。事实上，这些问题如此重大，以至于一个由69位权威神经科学家和认知心理学家组成的团队最近发表了一项声明，声称没有确凿的证据支持大脑训练倡导者的主张（Max Planck Institute for Human Development and Stanford Center on Longevity，2014）。著名期刊《科学》（Science）响应了这一报告，它嘲笑道：“对于正在老化的婴儿潮一代和老年人来说，最好的训练是去远足，而非坐在为助力大脑而设计的视频游戏前。”（Underwood，2014）
p86.en: However, looking more closely at these studies, you will find some major problems. In fact, these problems are so great that a team of 69 authoritative neuroscientists and cognitive psychologists recently issued a statement claiming that there is no conclusive evidence to support the claims of brain-training advocates (Max Planck Institute for Human Development and Stanford Center on Longevity, 2014). In response to this report, Science, a well-known journal, lamented: “For the ageing generation of babies and older people, the best training is to go hiking, not to sit in front of video games designed to help the brain. @Underwood, 2014

p87.original: 事实上，这些公司所吹捧的“研究”通常只是表明，玩电脑游戏的人会将这类游戏玩得更好。这离表明此类游戏能总体上促进认知或预防痴呆症，还差得很远。可以肯定的是，研究确实表明教育（但不一定是商业性的大脑训练产品）能够提高工作记忆和智商分数，但提高幅度不大：2～4分（Bryck & Fisher，2012；Hambrick，2014）。这并不是说我们永远不会看到有效的大脑训练程序出现——但到目前为止，专家们还是持反对态度。
p87.en: In fact, the “research” that these companies exemplify is usually simply an indication that people who play computer games will play such games better. This is far from demonstrating that such games can contribute to the general development of cognitive or dementia prevention. It is certain that research has shown that education (but not necessarily a commercial brain training product) can improve work memory and IQ scores, but not significantly: 2-4 points (Bryck & Fisher, 2012); Hambrick, 2014. That is not to say that we will never see an effective brain training process emerge — but experts have been opposed to it so far.

p88.original: 批判性思维的应用：性别差异问题
p88.en: Application of critical thinking: gender differences

p89.original: 2006年6月，哈佛大学校长拉里·萨摩斯（Larry Summers）博士丢了工作。原因之一是，他认为社会化以外的因素——其中最显著的是先天智力差异——可以解释在大多数科学领域男性人数多于女性（顺便说一句，心理学是个例外）这一不争事实。那么，到底发生了什么？需要你用你的批判性思维技能对证据进行诠释。
p89.en: In June 2006, Dr. Larry Summers, Rector of Harvard University, lost his job. One reason for this is that he believes that factors other than socialization — the most striking of which is the intellectual differences of birth — can explain the fact that in most scientific fields men outnumber women (by the way psychology is an exception). So, what the hell happened? I need you to interpret the evidence with your critical thinking skills.

p91.original: 关键问题是先天-后天之争：我们所看到的性别差异，是男性和女性不同的社会化方式导致的吗？是进入科学领域的女性受到偏见、歧视，以及缺乏机会导致的吗？还是由男女大脑不同的信息加工方式导致的？
p91.en: The key question is the innate-posterous struggle: are the gender differences that we see caused by the different ways in which men and women are socialized? Was it because of prejudice, discrimination and lack of opportunities for women entering the scientific field? Or is it caused by different ways of processing information in the brain of men and women?

p92.original: 相关结论是否存在被偏见污染的可能
p92.en: Whether there is a risk of contamination by prejudice

p93.original: 当然，我们首先想到的就是争论双方都可能存在偏见。除了潜在的“政治正确”问题之外，男女双方都有一个相关利益，就是确保自己的性别不会显得不如另一个性别聪明。
p93.en: Of course, what we thought first of all was that there might be bias on both sides of the dispute. In addition to the underlying “political correctness” issue, both men and women have a related interest in ensuring that their gender does not appear to be less intelligent than the other.

p94.original: 除却偏见，我们应该愿意根据证据的优劣来判断，也许也愿意从多个角度来看待这个问题。毕竟，双方可能都持有部分真理。
p94.en: Beyond prejudice, we should be willing to judge the merits of the evidence and perhaps to look at the issue from multiple perspectives. After all, both sides may hold part of the truth.

p95.en: What is the evidence of the “day after tomorrow” side?

p96.original: 珍妮特·希伯莱·海德（Hyde，2007）对有关性别的文献进行了详尽评述。她指出，在几乎所有已研究的维度上，男性和女性的相似性要远大于差异性——她将这种观点称为性别相似性假说（gender similarities hypothesis）。相似之处包括诸如数学能力、问题解决、阅读理解、领导效能和道德推理等多元特征。但也有少数例外，其中大多数你不会感到惊讶。这些包括男性具有更强的攻击性、对随意性行为的接受度，以及投掷速度——她承认这些差异可能会有生物根源。然而总体来说，海德偏向于强调男性和女性具有不同的社会化方式的解释。其中一个因素可能是社会在女孩成长中给她的整套期望（和限制）。海德说，男性和女性间存在的少量身体差异“之所以重要，主要是因为它们被文化信念和角色放大了”。
p96.en: The gender literature has been thoroughly reviewed by Janet Hyde 2007. She pointed out that in almost all the dimensions studied, the similarities between men and women were much greater than the differences - a view she described as gender similarity hypothesis (gender silarites hypothesis). Similarities include multiple features such as mathematical competence, problem resolution, reading understanding, leadership effectiveness and ethical reasoning. But there are a few exceptions, most of which you won't be surprised. These included greater male aggression, acceptance of casual sex and speed of delivery — she acknowledged that these differences could have biological roots. Overall, however, Hyde prefers to emphasize that men and women have different ways of socializing. One of these factors may be the set of expectations (and constraints) that society gives to girls in their development. Heidell said that the small physical differences between men and women “are important mainly because they are magnified by cultural beliefs and roles”.

p97.original: 海德进一步警告说，许多人都倾向于认为我们在男性和女性大脑中发现的任何男-女差异都是“固有的”、不可改变的。相反，她敦促我们将这些差异看作大脑可塑性的产物，这种可塑性使大脑的结构可被经验改变。事实上，大脑似乎一直在变化：过去十年进入科学领域的女性的人数急剧增加。例如，在现在美国医学院的毕业班学生中，女性占了一半（Halpern，2008）。
p97.en: Heidell further warned that many people tend to think that any male-female difference we find in the brain of men and women is “innate” and immutable. Instead, she urged us to view these differences as the product of the plasticity of the brain, which allows for empirical changes in the structure of the brain. In fact, the brain seems to be changing: the number of women entering science has increased dramatically over the past decade. For example, women now make up half of the graduates of the United States Medical School (Halpern, 2008).

p98.en: What is the evidence of the "genius" side?

p99.original: 罗伊·鲍迈斯特（Baumeister，2007）采用了一种截然不同的方法让我们注意到另外一些事实。他指出，作为一个群体，男性要比女性更加多变（variable）和极端（extreme）——在几乎所有心理和行为维度上，都有更多的男性位于极端。因此我们发现，在监狱、流浪者收容所中，在有智力障碍的人群中，男性多于女性；在爵士音乐家、科学家（除了心理学领域）、国会议员和我们称为“天才”的人中，亦是如此。鲍迈斯特说，如果男性比女性更易走极端，那么我们就会找到这些性别差异，但是男女的平均值可能是一样的。
p99.en: Baumeister, 2007 uses a very different approach to draw attention to other facts. He pointed out that, as a group, men were more variable than women (variable) and extremes (extreme) - more men than women were at extremes in almost all psychological and behavioural dimensions. As a result, in prisons, shelters for Travellers, there are more men than women among persons with intellectual disabilities; The same applies to jazz musicians, scientists (except in the area of psychology), parliamentarians and those we call “genius”. BOMIST said that if men were more extreme than women, we would find these gender differences, but the average for men and women might be the same.

p100.original: 鲍迈斯特也很快指出，他不认为一种性别优于另一种性别，只是因为进化为男性和女性选择了不同的特质。他说，一般来说，文化会给那些勇于冒险、拥有最极端技能的男性最高的回报。这些极端主义者、冒险者的孩子往往也是最多的，他们延续了这一趋势。鲍迈斯特认为，情况对女性来说则截然不同。女性的进化压力强调，女性比男性更注重安全——当你留下后代的机会在生理方面比男性更有限时，这确实是明智之举。
p100.en: BOMIST also quickly pointed out that he did not consider one sex to be superior to the other, simply because evolution chose different qualities for men and women. He said that, in general, culture offered the highest rewards to men who were brave and possessed the most extreme skills. These extremists, as well as the children of adventurers, tend to be the largest, and they perpetuate this trend. According to BOMIST, the situation is different for women. Women's evolving pressures stress that women are more safe than men — it is indeed wise when you have more biologically limited opportunities to leave children behind than men.

p101.original: 我们能够得出什么结论？

p102.original: 我们应该相信哪一方？正如我们早先提到的，双方都可能持有部分真理。双方都同意，能力中的性别差异很小。鲍迈斯特认为，性别差异更多与动机（特别是男性冒险的意愿）而非能力有关；而海德则认为这些差异主要是文化上的，因而可以对它们进行塑造。你必须自己找到这个问题的答案，但我们提醒你，你是一个批判性思考者，你要注意自己的偏见。最后，可能需要从多个角度来看待这个问题——就像内克尔立方体（necker cube）[5]不断变化的角度一样。
p102.en: Which side should we trust? As we mentioned earlier, both sides may hold part of the truth. Both sides agreed that there was a small gender gap in capacity. (a) According to BOMEST, gender differences are more related to motivation (especially the willingness of men to take risks) than to ability; Heidel, for his part, believes that these differences are mainly cultural and can be shaped. You have to find the answer to that question, but we remind you that you are a critical thinker and you have to be aware of your prejudices. Finally, the issue may need to be viewed from a number of angles - just as the necker cube[5] is constantly changing.
